project_implication: RP1 AD1 current ideal-root 8.83 N m factored demand produces 7.301 MPa and 1.805 mm under E=1 GPa / 5 MPa screen and 15 mm gussets. The 1 mm deflection and same demand remain; kit motor labels do not justify thinner replacement or change to demand or limits. The differing fin geometries, mass and loading invalidate direct capacity comparison. No replacement adopted or shown passing.
